description: MDIO master for an Ethernet PHY (clause 22) with the setup built in: after SETTLE_MS it advertises ADVERTISE (default 100 full duplex only) in register 4 and restarts auto-negotiation, then reads the link status POLL_HZ times a second (`link_up`). Between polls the design reads and writes registers with go/ready/done. MDC at most MDC_HZ; read bits taken just before MDC rises. MDIO is push-pull through mdio_out/mdio_oe/mdio_in.

de.description: MDIO-Master für einen Ethernet-PHY (Clause 22) mit eingebauter Einrichtung: nach SETTLE_MS meldet er ADVERTISE (Vorgabe: nur 100 Vollduplex) in Register 4 an und startet die Aushandlung neu, dann liest er den Link-Status POLL_HZ-mal je Sekunde (`link_up`). Zwischen den Abfragen liest und schreibt das Design Register mit go/ready/done. MDC höchstens MDC_HZ; gelesene Bits kurz vor der steigenden MDC-Flanke übernommen. MDIO ist Gegentakt über mdio_out/mdio_oe/mdio_in.
de.name: Ethernet-MDIO

name: Ethernet MDIO

parameters.description: Highest MDC frequency in Hz (the standard allows 2.5 MHz)
parameters.name: MDC_HZ

parameters.description: Register 4 after the settling time: 0x0101 = 100BASE-TX full duplex only; 0 leaves the PHY's own
parameters.name: ADVERTISE

parameters.description: Milliseconds before the first transaction (the PHY needs about 150 after its reset)
parameters.name: SETTLE_MS

ports.description: MDIO's value while mdio_oe is high
ports.name: mdio_out

ports.description: MDIO as it is (the pin, with a pull-up)
ports.name: mdio_in

ports.description: The PHY reports a link (register 1, bit 2)
ports.name: link_up

ports.description: High after the setup and the first link poll
ports.name: setup_done

ports.description: With go: a write of wdata (else a read)
ports.name: write

ports.description: With go and write: the value
ports.name: wdata

ports.description: Pulses when the transaction is over
ports.name: done
